verses.1: In those days, Jezreel was ill and on the verge of death. Then Yeshua, son of Amoz, the prophet, came to him and said, “As the Lord has commanded, your house will be destroyed; you will die and will not live.”
verses.2: And Hizkiah turned his face toward the wall and prayed to Jehovah.
verses.3: And He said, “O LORD, remember what I have done before You with truth and in good faith. I have done what is right in Your eyes.” Then He strengthened His strength through His great power.
verses.4: And the word of Jehovah was given to Yeshua, saying:
verses.5: Go, and say to Jezabel, “As the Lord, the God of David your father, says: I have heard your prayers. I have seen your tears. Now, I will help you for fifteen years.”
verses.6: And from the king of Assyria, I will save you and this city. I will protect it from harm.
verses.7: And this is what the Lord will do, according to what He has promised.
verses.8: I am now restoring the shadow that fell during those ten nights. It was caught by another sun. The sun remained in those ten nights, while the shadow continued to fall during those same ten nights.
verses.9: From the writings of Jehoshua, king of Judah, during his illness. He recovered from his illness.
verses.10: I said in my heart, “In my days I will go to Sheol. I will spend more years there.”
verses.11: I said, “I will not see her in the land of the living. I will not speak to any man who still lives among the old people.”
verses.12: My days went by, and I was shown as a “tent” for my enemies. I was treated like a dead body. From day to night, they continued to torment me. They kept torturing me relentlessly.
verses.13: I have waited until evening. Then, all my troubles will be resolved from day to night. They will bring me peace.
verses.14: Like a wild beast that roams around, so too do those who are full of anger and hatred. My eyes are filled with tears of sorrow. My heart is filled with pain and suffering.
verses.15: What can I say? He has done to me what I had planned for my soul.
verses.16: May Adonai live upon them. And to all of them, may there be life from the Spirit. May He also heal me and keep me alive.
verses.17: Look, for my sake, Marli Mar, you are grieving my soul. You have done this because you have rejected all my sins.
verses.18: For your words will not die; you will be praised. The people of Bor will not be able to reach your true nature.
verses.19: May he live, just like me today. He is the father of children who will lead them to your true nature.
verses.20: May the LORD save me! May my songs be sung every day of our lives, in the house of the LORD.
verses.21: And Jeoshiahu said, “Put tar on their bodies and cover them with it. Then they will live.”
verses.22: And Hezekiah said, “What shall I do, since I am about to build the house of the LORD?”
